title: SELECT and column projection
objective: Choose only the columns required by the question.

title: WHERE filtering
objective: Filter records using exact stored values and documented population rules.

title: ORDER BY and LIMIT
objective: Sort results and return Top-N records.

title: DISTINCT
objective: Return unique stored categories without inventing normalization.

title: NULL handling
objective: Distinguish NULL from zero and non-NULL values.

title: CASE expressions
objective: Create an explicit classification from a documented threshold.

title: COALESCE and zero-order outlets
objective: Keep eligible outlets without orders and represent missing aggregate values deliberately.

title: Aggregate functions
objective: Use SUM, COUNT, and AVG at the intended grain.

title: GROUP BY
objective: Aggregate records by category, hour, or month.

title: HAVING and duplicate checks
objective: Filter grouped results to identify repeated keys.

title: Date and time functions
objective: Extract hour, year, and calendar month.

title: String functions and stored labels
objective: Inspect and filter stored text values without silent recategorization.

title: INNER JOIN
objective: Combine related records when matching rows are required.

title: LEFT JOIN and unmatched rows
objective: Preserve parent rows with no matching child records.

title: Join cardinality and double counting
objective: Separate order-level and detail-level metrics.

title: Common Table Expressions
objective: Break multi-stage analysis into named query steps.

title: Subqueries
objective: Use a query result as a filter or scalar input.

title: Window functions and ranking
objective: Rank rows while retaining individual result rows.

title: Percentages and running totals
objective: Calculate within-group share and cumulative contribution.

title: Cross-sell pairs and analytical validation
objective: Count unique item combinations and validate metric consistency.

title: Staff salary aggregation
objective: Aggregate the CSV-provided monthly_salary field by role and outlet after verifying the live PostgreSQL schema.
